author: FRONTLINE PBS | Official
description:
Israel is preparing to hold its first national election since the Oct. 7, 2023, Hamas-led attacks and the vote is shaping up to be a major test for Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.

For decades, Netanyahu has built his political career on a promise to keep Israelis safe. But with Oct. 7 happening on his watch, his opponents are challenging that reputation.

With Israelis heading to the polls this week, FRONTLINE examines the political playbook that made Netanyahu the country's longest-serving prime minister and whether it can work again.
title: What’s at Stake in Israel’s Consequential Election?
